    Install

    R 

    # install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("rdazadda/CANHR-color-schemes")

    Stata 

    net install canhr, from("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rdazadda/CANHR-color-schemes/main/") replace

    Use

    R 

    library(canhrcolors)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = drv)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_canhr(labels = c("4WD", "Front", "Rear")) +
  theme_canhr() +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel economy by engine size",
    x = "Engine displacement (litres)",
    y = "Highway miles per gallon",
    color = "Drive"
  )

    Stata 

    set scheme canhr

sysuse citytemp, clear
graph bar (mean) tempjan tempjuly, over(region) ///
    title("Average temperature by region") ///
    ytitle("Degrees Fahrenheit") ///
    legend(order(1 "January" 2 "July"))

    Add , permanently to set scheme to make it your default.
